scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a VA loan to refinance my home. I was wondering if you could tell me the status of my application? Also, I'd like to know if my application was approved, denied, or is still pending.
dialogue.agent: Your VA loan application for refinancing has been approved and the loan has been originated.

dialogue.user: That's great news! Could you please tell me what my interest rate and the total costs of this loan are? Also, I'd like to know if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan.
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 5.99%. The total loan costs are $10,587.26. Your loan does not have high-cost mortgage or negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Could you also tell me if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? Additionally, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan was sold to Ginnie Mae. You were approved for a VA:First Lien loan product.

dialogue.user: Got it. Just one more thing, what is my debt-to-income ratio and how does it affect my application?
dialogue.agent: The record does not include your debt-to-income ratio.

dialogue.user: I see. Thank you for your help. <Satisfied> The agent was able to provide all the information I needed about my loan status, interest rate, total costs, and loan type. They also confirmed that my loan was sold to another institution, which is useful to know. The only thing they couldn't provide was my debt-to-income ratio, but that's understandable. Overall, I'm satisfied with the interaction.
